summary: The supplied captures show a readable queue and detail view with clear selection, status, and review actions. The visible issues are limited to filter spacing and risk chart labeling.

findings.description: [defect] At 1440 px, the Approved filter wraps onto a line by itself even though the space to the right of Changes Requested can accommodate it. This adds a row above the specification list.

[defect] The Risk Distribution chart gives seven bars no visible labels or scale. The average is explicit, but a reviewer cannot identify which specification a bar represents or read its score from the chart.
